content: अप्रतीत {%a.%} .²1 Not pleased or delighted; को न्वनेनाप्रतीतेन (संप्रीयेत) <ls>Rām. 2. 48. 20</ls>. .²2 Unapproached; unassailable. <ls>Av. 7. 25. 1</ls>. .²3 Unopposed. .²4 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Not understood or clearly intelligible (as a word), one of the defects of a word (शब्ददोष); अप्रतीतं यत्केवले शास्त्रे प्रसिद्धम् <ls>K. P. 7</ls>, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} a word is said to be अप्रतीत if it be used in a sense which it has in particular classes of works only (and not in general or popular use); {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} सम्यग्ज्ञानमहाज्योतिर्दलिताशयताजुषः (where आशय = वासना occurs in Yogaśāstra only).
